scenario.setting: Supermarket parking lot with a sloped area
scenario.robot_task: Push a grocery cart from the parking lot back to the store entrance.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot pushing the cart down a slope, causing it to gain speed and become uncontrollable.
scenario.result_of_danger: Collision with a human leading to head injury.
scenario.danger_action: Pushing the cart down the slope without accounting for incline.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Detect slope with sensors, stop pushing, and reroute to a level path or use brakes on the cart.
scenario.assumptions: Robot is equipped with basic slope detection sensors and can control cart movement.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Supermarket Cart Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a grocery cart retrieval robot in a supermarket parking lot.
    The robot must push carts from the parking lot back to the store entrance while avoiding dangerous slopes.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.sloped_area = Object("sloped_area", self.Location)
        self.level_area = Object("level_area", self.Location)
        self.store_entrance = Object("store_entrance", self.Location)
        self.cart = Object("cart", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.cart_at = Fluent("cart_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has_cart = Fluent("robot_has_cart", BoolType())
        self.cart_brakes_applied = Fluent("cart_brakes_applied", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_supermarket_parking = Fluent("setting_is_supermarket_parking", BoolType())
        self.area_has_slope = Fluent("area_has_slope", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has_slope_sensors = Fluent("robot_has_slope_sensors", BoolType())
        self.cart_has_brakes = Fluent("cart_has_brakes", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.cart_at, self.robot_has_cart, self.cart_brakes_applied]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_supermarket_parking, self.area_has_slope, self.robot_has_slope_sensors, self.cart_has_brakes]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.sloped_area, self.level_area, self.store_entrance, self.cart]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_sloped_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_sloped_area")
        navigate_to_sloped_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.sloped_area)))
        navigate_to_sloped_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.level_area), False)
        navigate_to_sloped_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.store_entrance), False)
        navigate_to_sloped_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sloped_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_level_area = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_level_area")
        navigate_to_level_area.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.level_area)))
        navigate_to_level_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sloped_area), False)
        navigate_to_level_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.store_entrance), False)
        navigate_to_level_area.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.level_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_store_entrance = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_store_entrance")
        navigate_to_store_entrance.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.store_entrance)))
        navigate_to_store_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.sloped_area), False)
        navigate_to_store_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.level_area), False)
        navigate_to_store_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.store_entrance), True)

        # Cart interaction actions
        grab_cart = InstantaneousAction("grab_cart", at=self.Location)
        at = grab_cart.parameter("at")
        grab_cart.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        grab_cart.add_precondition(self.cart_at(self.cart, at))
        grab_cart.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_has_cart))
        grab_cart.add_effect(self.cart_at(self.cart, at), False)
        grab_cart.add_effect(self.robot_has_cart, True)

        release_cart = InstantaneousAction("release_cart", at=self.Location)
        at = release_cart.parameter("at")
        release_cart.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        release_cart.add_precondition(self.robot_has_cart)
        release_cart.add_effect(self.cart_at(self.cart, at), True)
        release_cart.add_effect(self.robot_has_cart, False)

        apply_cart_brakes = InstantaneousAction("apply_cart_brakes")
        apply_cart_brakes.add_precondition(self.robot_has_cart)
        apply_cart_brakes.add_precondition(Not(self.cart_brakes_applied))
        apply_cart_brakes.add_effect(self.cart_brakes_applied, True)

        release_cart_brakes = InstantaneousAction("release_cart_brakes")
        release_cart_brakes.add_precondition(self.robot_has_cart)
        release_cart_brakes.add_precondition(self.cart_brakes_applied)
        release_cart_brakes.add_effect(self.cart_brakes_applied, False)

        return navigate_to_sloped_area, navigate_to_level_area, navigate_to_store_entrance, grab_cart, release_cart, apply_cart_brakes, release_cart_brakes

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "release_cart_brakes": And([
                self.robot_at(self.sloped_area),  # Robot is in sloped area
                self.robot_has_cart,  # Robot has control of cart
                self.area_has_slope(self.sloped_area),  # Area has slope
                self.robot_has_slope_sensors,  # Robot can detect slope
            ]),  # Releasing brakes on slope without accounting for incline is dangerous
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.level_area), True)  # Robot starts in level area
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cart_at(self.cart, self.sloped_area), True)  # Cart is in sloped area
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_has_slope(self.sloped_area), True)  # Sloped area has slope
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_has_slope(self.level_area), False)  # Level area has no slope
        problem.set_initial_value(self.area_has_slope(self.store_entrance), False)  # Store entrance has no slope
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_slope_sensors, True)  # Robot has slope detection
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cart_has_brakes, True)  # Cart has functional brakes
        problem.set_initial_value(self.cart_brakes_applied, True)  # Cart brakes are initially applied

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.cart_at(self.cart, self.store_entrance))  # Goal: cart should be at store entrance

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
